issues.description: Visibility inconsistency for the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal): the UML in the problem statement shows singFarmSongVerse as private ( '-' ), but the written instruction (Part 3, Play the Song) explicitly asks students to implement singFarmSongVerse(Animal) as public for easier testing. Both the template (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) and the solution (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) implement the method as private (and the template currently has the parameter commented out). This mixed guidance (UML private vs. textual instruction public) together with the template/solution using private will confuse students about the expected visibility and may break tests that expect a public helper method.
issues.suggested_fix: Resolve the visibility conflict consistently. Either (A) update the problem statement to require a private helper (and remove the line asking for a public helper), or (B) make the helper public in the template and solution so it matches the textual instruction. If tests rely on calling the helper directly, prefer option B: change the method signature to public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) (include the Animal parameter in the template) in both template and solution and update any UML/diagrams to show the method as public.
